data.long_meaning: Rawwad is an Arabic name that means 'one who guides' or 'leader'. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a noble name that symbolizes guidance and direction. The name Rawwad carries the meaning “One who guides” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rawwad usually hope their child will grow to embody one who guides and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Rawwad is a colloquial name that is relatively uncommon in contemporary usage, but it holds a significant place in Islamic history and literature. In Arabic literature, Rawwad is also the name of a noble character in the epic poem "The Conference of the Birds" by Attar of Nishapur. This character is known for his wisdom, knowledge, and courage, making the name symbolic of leadership, guidance, and strength within a community.
